caption: The circuit breaker state machine: calls flow while closed, a run of failures opens it so that callers fail fast and use the fallback, and after a cool-down a few trial calls decide whether it closes again.
alt: Three states. Closed: calls pass through and failures are counted. When failures cross the threshold it moves to Open: calls fail immediately and the fallback is used. After the cool-down it moves to Half-open: a few trial calls are allowed. If they succeed it returns to Closed; if they fail it returns to Open.
